title: Volcano with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='sky' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#3a1d5e'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#6b2fa0'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='lava' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffb13b'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ff5722'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- mountain body -->
  <path d='M8 92 L36 34 L50 30 L64 34 L92 92 Z' fill='#7a4a2b'/>
  <path d='M50 30 L64 34 L92 92 L50 92 Z' fill='#5c3520'/>

  <!-- snow-ish top rim -->
  <path d='M36 34 L50 30 L64 34 L58 40 L50 37 L42 40 Z' fill='#c26a3d'/>

  <!-- crater lava glow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='32' rx='15' ry='5' fill='#ff8a3b'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='31' rx='10' ry='3' fill='#ffd76e'/>

  <!-- lava flow down the slope -->
  <path d='M43 34 Q40 48 45 60 Q50 72 44 84' stroke='#ff7a2e' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M43 34 Q40 48 45 60 Q50 72 44 84' stroke='#ffd76e' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M59 34 Q63 46 57 56' stroke='#ff7a2e' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- cute face -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='58' r='4.2' fill='#2a1533'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='58' r='4.2' fill='#2a1533'/>
  <circle cx='42.4' cy='56.6' r='1.4' fill='#ffe9b0'/>
  <circle cx='60.4' cy='56.6' r='1.4' fill='#ffe9b0'/>
  <circle cx='33' cy='66' r='3.4' fill='#ff9d7a' opacity='0.85'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='66' r='3.4' fill='#ff9d7a' opacity='0.85'/>

  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M42 68 Q50 77 58 68' stroke='#2a1533' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- little sparks floating from crater -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='22' r='2.2' fill='#ffd76e'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='18' r='2.6' fill='#ffb13b'/>
  <circle cx='51' cy='14' r='1.8' fill='#ffe9b0'/>
</svg>
